errors.text_span: свързан със самооценката на компетентността по отношение на киберсигурността
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the question is about self-assessment of competence. The chart's title, 'Смятате ли, че хората от киберсигурността, с които сте си взаимодействали, са компетентни?' (Do you think the cybersecurity people you've interacted with are competent?), clearly indicates that the question is about assessing the competence of others, not oneself.

The description incorrectly transcribes one of the x-axis categories. The label in the figure is 'Не мога да преценя;' (I can't judge;), not 'Не желая да преценявам' (I don't want to judge). This error is repeated later in the description.
The description fails to mention that the vertical axis does not have a visible text label. While it correctly infers that the axis represents frequency, it omits the detail that it is unlabeled.
